get.description: GEL per `quantity` units, one row per day a rate starts (`validFrom`). The rate for a date is the row with the greatest `validFrom` on or before it (SPEC §2.3).

post.summary: Queue a backfill of NBG rates for a date range (admin)
post.description: Idempotent: dates already stored are not duplicated. Emits `rates.backfilled` when done. Temporary admin check: the `x-admin-token` header (replaced by WS-05).
